plain.li: Sat through {GATHERING} with an empty plate. Nothing on the table was anything I could eat.
The others ate well at {GATHERING}. I had water and the company, and the company was most of it.
I went to {GATHERING} and ate nothing. I'll go through the stores tomorrow.
[diet:fungusinsect] Not one dish at {GATHERING} had fungus or insect meat in it. I sat and listened, and ate later.
[diet:fungusinsect] The cooks made a good spread for {GATHERING}. None of it would have stayed down, so I left it.
[diet:vegetarian] Every plate at {GATHERING} had meat in it. I passed them along and stayed for the talk.
[diet:vegan] Meat, eggs or milk in everything at {GATHERING}. I kept my hands in my lap.
[diet:carnivore] Nothing at {GATHERING} but grain and greens. I'll find some meat tomorrow.
[diet:fungus] Plates full of greens at {GATHERING}, and not a cap of fungus among them. I didn't touch them.
[diet:nofungus] Fungus in every pot at {GATHERING}. I said I'd eaten already.
[diet:fine] Simple meals at {GATHERING}. I'd rather go without than eat like that at a feast.

warm.li: Nothing at {GATHERING} was for me, but they kept a seat for me all the same. That mattered more.
[diet:vegetarian] Someone noticed my empty plate at {GATHERING} and said next time there'd be a dish without meat. I believe them.
[diet:fungusinsect] I couldn't eat a thing at {GATHERING}, but I wouldn't have missed the stories.

blunt.li: A feast, and not one thing I could eat. Next time, ask.
[diet:fungusinsect] Not a single dish at {GATHERING} I could keep down. Somebody should have thought of that.
[diet:carnivore] They call that a feast? Not a scrap of meat on the table.

cheerful.li: Ate nothing at {GATHERING} and still had the best evening in weeks. I'll raid the stores later.

gloomy.li: Everyone ate at {GATHERING} but me. I watched the plates go round.
[diet:fungusinsect] The others ate at {GATHERING}. I sat with an empty bowl and felt a long way from them.

cold.li: Attended {GATHERING}. No suitable food. Ate later.
